title: Jobs and their tasks
subject: Careers

thread_tags.line: Thread tags: SMSC S/So (M/C: none); British Values IL/MR (D/RL/T: none).
thread_tags.rationale: S: reflect on skills or choices. So: listen and share task talk. IL: choose a response mode and task route. MR: value different skills and roles without ranking people.

label: Public edition
objective_verbatim: Match two job roles to the tasks people do.
display_objective: Match two job roles to the tasks people do.
approved_activity: Sort picture cards showing tasks in fictional shop, stockroom and garden settings.
Choose a role, match its tasks and give one reason for the choice.
calendar_note: Year A. 9–13 November 2026. One 40-minute lesson. No day or clock slot inferred. Week 7 is assessing.
where_this_leads: This helps me find out what different jobs involve.
unit: Strengths, job roles and work skills
accreditation: The qualification and the accredited unit: any mapping is for staff to confirm from the actual evidence. No criteria or completion are inferred.
assessment: Weeks 1–6 are formative. Week 7 is the assessing lesson. Keep actual responses, support, gaps and next steps in the evidence record.

sources.note: The owner-approved standalone Careers outline is the weekly teaching source. The combined independence, careers and vocational workbook rows supply context, not substitute weekly objectives.
Background on independence, recognising jobs and taking responsibility. Identifying labels use generic wording. The raw workbook is not redistributed.

authoring_provenance.note: Newly authored tasks from the owner-approved Careers outline. Context cells are not presented as separate weekly Careers rows.

external_sources.note: Approval, curriculum context, template and authored visual provenance.

evidence.description: Two recorded job-to-task matches and the learner’s reason, spoken, selected or written.
evidence.status: not prefilled; actual response and support to be recorded

routes.Supported: Supported: choose between two role cards; make two job-to-task matches with reading support.
routes.Independent: Independent: sort all six task cards, then record two different role matches and one reason.
routes.Aspire: Aspire: explain how a skill could be used in more than one role, using the supplied briefs.

vocab.definition: A part you have in a job.
A place where goods are sold.

cases.judgement: Shop: the brief includes arranging tins.
cases.next_step: Ask the learner to link the task to the role card.

cases.text: Help a shopper find a tin.
cases.judgement: Shop: the brief includes helping shoppers.
cases.next_step: Accept a spoken or selected reason supported by the brief.

cases.judgement: Store: the brief includes checking boxes.
cases.next_step: Point out that store here means the stockroom setting.

cases.text: Put boxes in a safe row.
cases.judgement: Store: the brief includes putting boxes in rows.
cases.next_step: This is a paper-card task; no lifting is required.

cases.judgement: Garden: the brief includes watering plants.
cases.next_step: Ask which part of the brief supports the match.

cases.judgement: Garden: the brief includes caring for plant beds.
cases.next_step: Explain bed as a patch of soil for plants; no gardening tools are used.
